verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a Create Adjustment Journal Entry API endpoint that takes an account_uuid and debit or credit amounts, along with a Manual Journal Entry report. Its accounting docs also say the accountant can update journal entries and the chart of accounts. This delivers the core of posting manual journal entries. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that debits must equal credits, documented memo or description fields on entries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
